title: Employer Group Contracts Training Notes: Census Reports and Participation at Renewal
content:
**The rule.** Under Employer Group Contracts the employer reports its eligible and enrolled employees every census reporting interval of its Cascade Group Dental & Vision segment and with each renewal; employees who waive because they have other dental coverage are left out of the eligible count when the segment schedule excludes such waivers. Participation is measured at renewal on the latest census against the minimum for the contribution type; a group below its minimum is told in the renewal notice and has the segment's participation cure period to cure, after which the contract is not renewed. A census showing eligible employees outside the segment's range moves the group to the matching segment at the next renewal.

**The measure.** Participation is the enrolled employees divided by the eligible employees reported, after leaving out valid waivers with other coverage, expressed as an integer percent rounded down. It is read from the latest census report dated on or before the renewal measurement date. Each census report records its report date, the enrolled employees and the eligible employees.

## Questions answered

**Which census report is used at renewal?**
The latest one reported on or before the renewal measurement date. Hypothetically, with census reports dated in March and in September and a measurement date in October, the September report is used; a report dated after the measurement date is not the latest report on or before it.

**How is the percentage worked out and rounded?**
Enrolled employees divided by the eligible count, rounded down to a whole percent. Hypothetical figures, with an eligible count of 40 after leaving out waivers with other coverage:

| Enrolled employees | Exact share | Participation |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | 75 percent | 75 percent |
| 29 | 72.5 percent | 72 percent |
| 26 | 65 percent | 65 percent |

**When is a group below its minimum?**
When its participation is lower than the minimum for its contribution type. Against a hypothetical minimum of 75 percent, participation of 75 percent is not below it, and 72 percent is.

**What follows a shortfall?**
The group is told in the renewal notice and has the segment's participation cure period, counted in calendar days after that renewal notice, to cure it; a shortfall not cured within it means the contract is not renewed.

**What does a census with an eligible count outside the segment's range do?**
It moves the group to the matching segment at the next renewal. Hypothetically, a group in the Cascade Group Dental & Vision 20-49 segment whose census shows 53 eligible employees moves to the 50-99 segment at its next renewal.
